note: Which catalogue ingredients or groups fill a role of a ratio card (flour, water, egg, fat, sugar, oil, acid, liquid, salt: packages/engine/data/templates.json) or a role of a dish (crunch, garnish). A role on a group covers every food below it. Every entry is a judgement of the person who wrote it, stated in `basis`; none comes from the USDA data, which carries no roles. Tap water is a catalogue entry since 2026-11-24 and has the role water; the finder treats the role water as the kitchen's, so no stock is asked for it.
